Mumbai incidents highlight civic safety lapses and infrastructure issues

Multiple incidents in Mumbai, including a manhole death and building collapses, have brought civic safety and infrastructure concerns to the forefront. Authorities have responded with suspensions, arrests, and inspections, while political parties are demanding accountability and policy changes. These events underscore ongoing challenges with urban infrastructure maintenance and public safety in the city.
